listen_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) the proxy will bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 to bind to all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Port number the proxy listens on.

user.description: System username to drop privileges to after startup (must exist).

group.description: System group for the privileged user.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections.

client_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for client request data before closing the connection.

server_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for upstream server response before timing out.

enable_ipv6.description: Whether to enable IPv6 support for outgoing and incoming connections.

log_file.description: Path to log file; use '-' to log to standard output.

auth_users.description: List of users allowed to use the proxy via HTTP Basic authentication.

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed destination hosts/globs (e.g., '*.example.com'). If empty, all hosts are allowed unless denied.

blocked_hosts.description: List of denied destination hosts/globs. Checked after 'allowed_hosts' rules.

enable_pipelining.description: Enable HTTP/1.1 request pipelining for improved performance on fast upstream links.

max_request_size_kb.description: Maximum HTTP request body size in KB. Set to 0 for no limit.

enable_keepalive.description: Enable HTTP/1.1 keep-alive for upstream connections.

request_headers.description: Custom headers to add to all outgoing HTTP requests.

response_headers.description: Custom headers to add to all incoming HTTP responses.

body_replacements.description: Search-and-replace patterns applied to response bodies (first match per line only).

upstream_proxy.description: Upstream proxy server to forward requests to (optional chain).

username.description: Username for upstream proxy auth (leave blank if none).

disable_via_header.description: If true, suppress the 'Via:' header in requests to avoid proxy identification.

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent string sent to upstream servers. Leave empty to use default.
